brief.zh: 每一拍回答：总线这一拍的位和上一拍一样吗？第一拍拿它和 1 比。
brief.en: Every tick, answer: is the bit on the bus the same as the tick before? On the first tick, compare it with 1.

t.zh: 能记住上一拍以后，就能看出线什么时候变了。新元件<part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>：两个值相等时给出「是」，不相等给出「否」；它还有一种形状「小于」。
t.en: Remembering the last tick, the board can tell when the line changes. A new part, <part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>: yes when its two values are equal, no when they are not; it has a second form, Less than.

after.zh: 一张寄存卡加一个比较，板就看得出线在哪一拍变了。
after.en: A register and a comparison, and the board can see the tick the line changes.
